_comment: Debug rendering config. Renders an annotated .mp4 plus a per-frame JSONL so a run can be inspected rather than trusted. Select it with TRAFFIC_CONFIG=configs/debug_render.json. It extends the tuned runtime config so that a partial override cannot silently fall back to the duplicated built-in defaults in src/config.py -- which is how an earlier version of this file quietly ran with different thresholds than the ones that had been measured.
